en.html:
《I question life and death, setting the choice myself as my appointed problem.》
《Then let comedy's curtain rise amid the joyous whirl of mockery.》

《A dog howling through a stormy night fights bravely against a foolish thief.》
《A chick awaiting its parent in a warm nest rests inside a serpent's belly.》
《A lion born beneath the filtered sun feasts upon a thousand deer.》
《Frog eggs hearing the stream are gathered and crushed by a child.》

《Believer in life's meaning, hear the clown's sincere sophistry.》
《Trembler before death, the devil's mask is a blackened mirror.》
《Question life, and clown and devil take up their spoons.》
《Believe in life and abandon yourself to it, and clown and devil remove their crowns.》
《Beasts, dance and race the fields; sing, shout, rage and run.》
《Now every chain and cage before you is crumbling earth.》
